title: Revet Ethan personal-track Q&A within a small-model call cap
body: Preserve the 21 answered items and audit trail; rewrite the 16 lopsided items, judge replacements with fewer votes and a smaller model, and enforce a hard per-run call limit.
summary: Replaced Track P paid vote-parity gate with zero-call qualitative review of both options; rewrote 16 Ethan questions, preserved 21 raw answers, reviewed 37 rows (21 active, 16 pending). Full suite passed 833 tests, 3 skipped; origin/main includes 7db6a5da.
